SELECT

    eai.mthincome,
    eai.addincome,
    eai.hshincome,
    eai.debincratio,
    eaa.mthexp,
    eaa.savamount,
    eaa.investamt,
    eaa.liqassets,
    eaa.totassets,
    eaa.totliabs,
    eaa.networth,
    eaa.vehvalue,
    eaa.bankaccbal,
    eaa.propfinancialdata->>'propvalue' AS propvalue,
    eaa.propfinancialdata->'mortgagebits'->>'mortbalance' AS mortbalance,

    bat.lifeinsval,

    cah.totcredlimit,

    cah.totloanamt,

    core_record AS cr

    employment_and_income AS eai ON cr.coreregistry = eai.emplcoreref

    expenses_and_assets AS eaa ON eai.emplcoreref = eaa.expemplref
JOIN
    bank_and_transactions AS bat ON eaa.expemplref = bat.bankexpref
JOIN
    credit_and_compliance AS cac ON bat.bankexpref = cac.compbankref
JOIN
    credit_accounts_and_history AS cah ON cac.compbankref = cah.histcompref;

WITH SegmentDebt AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.clientseg AS customer_segment,
        t2.debincratio AS debt_to_income_ratio
    FROM 
        core_record AS t1
    JOIN 
        employment_and_income AS t2 ON t1.coreregistry = t2.emplcoreref
),
SegmentStats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_segment,
        AVG(debt_to_income_ratio) AS avg_debt_to_income_ratio,
        COUNT(customer_segment) AS customer_count
    FROM 
        SegmentDebt
    GROUP BY 
        customer_segment
),
GrandTotal AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(avg_debt_to_income_ratio) AS grand_total_avg
    FROM 
        SegmentStats
)
SELECT 
    ss.customer_segment,
    ss.avg_debt_to_income_ratio
FROM 
    SegmentStats ss
WHERE 
    ss.customer_count >= 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    NULL AS customer_segment,
    gt.grand_total_avg AS avg_debt_to_income_ratio
FROM 
    GrandTotal gt
ORDER BY 
    avg_debt_to_income_ratio DESC;

033545962eac5479797561640c0bcfec0d0c9f0f.sql:
WITH liquidity_measure AS (
  SELECT 
    e.expemplref, 
    liqassets, 
    totassets, 
    (liqassets / totassets) AS alr, 
    investamt, 
    mthincome 
  FROM 
    "expenses_and_assets" AS e 
  JOIN "employment_and_income" AS m ON e.expemplref = m.emplcoreref
), 
label_investment_potential AS (
  SELECT 
    expemplref, 
    CASE 
      WHEN alr > 0.5 AND mthincome > 5000 THEN 'Target' 
      ELSE 'Standard' 
    END AS label 
  FROM 
    liquidity_measure
) 
SELECT 
  c.clientref, 
  lq.liqassets, 
  lq.totassets, 
  lq.alr AS "liquidity measure", 
  lq.mthincome AS "monthly income", 
  lq.investamt AS "investment amount", 
  lp.label AS "label of investment potential" 
FROM 
  "core_record" AS c 
  JOIN liquidity_measure AS lq ON c.coreregistry = lq.expemplref 
  JOIN label_investment_potential AS lp ON lq.expemplref = lp.expemplref;

WITH segment_debt_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.clientseg AS customer_segment,
        AVG(t2.debincratio) AS avg_debt_to_income_ratio,
        COUNT(t1.clientseg) AS customer_count
    FROM core_record AS t1
    JOIN employment_and_income AS t2 ON t1.coreregistry = t2.emplcoreref
    GROUP BY t1.clientseg
),
filtered_segments AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_segment,
        avg_debt_to_income_ratio
    FROM segment_debt_summary
    WHERE customer_count >= 10
)
SELECT 
    customer_segment,
    avg_debt_to_income_ratio
FROM filtered_segments
ORDER BY avg_debt_to_income_ratio ASC;

WITH vulnerability_score AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.clientref AS customer_id, 
    (0.5 * t2.debincratio) + (0.5 * LEAST(6, t3.liqassets / NULLIF(t3.mthexp, 0))) AS vulnerability_score, 
    t3.networth AS net_worth, 
    t4.delinqcount AS delinquency_count, 
    t4.latepaycount AS late_payment_count 
  FROM 
    core_record AS t1 
    JOIN employment_and_income AS t2 ON t1.coreregistry = t2.emplcoreref 
    JOIN expenses_and_assets AS t3 ON t2.emplcoreref = t3.expemplref 
    JOIN credit_and_compliance AS t4 ON t3.expemplref = t4.compbankref
) 
SELECT 
  customer_id, 
  vulnerability_score, 
  net_worth, 
  delinquency_count, 
  late_payment_count 
FROM 
  vulnerability_score 
WHERE 
  vulnerability_score > 0;
